activate_strength.description: Automates the overworld activation of the STRENGTH move from the party menu by navigating to the second party member (ROCKY/GEODUDE) and selecting the STRENGTH option.
activate_strength.python_script:
import json

# Standard button sequence to activate STRENGTH in overworld:
# 1. Start (opens menu)
# 2. Down (points to POKeMON if cursor starts at top, or we can press B first to reset)
# 3. A (selects POKeMON)
# 4. Down (points to ROCKY/GEODUDE in slot 2)
# 5. A (selects ROCKY)
# 6. A (selects STRENGTH, which is the first option)
# 7. sleep 1500 (waits for dialog)
# 8. A (advances dialog)

buttons = [
    "Start",
    "sleep 1000",
    "Down",
    "sleep 500",
    "A",
    "sleep 1000",
    "Down",
    "sleep 500",
    "A",
    "sleep 1000",
    "A",
    "sleep 1500",
    "A"
]

print(json.dumps(buttons))

history.commit_message: Define activate_strength tool to automate the STRENGTH overworld activation from the party menu.
